brief:
South Africa has submitted a dossier to the International Court of Justice accusing Israel of failing to comply with the court's legally binding provisional measures, Middle East Eye reported. The submission outlines alleged violations of orders issued by the ICJ in South Africa's case against Israel at the global court.

Provisional measures are emergency orders designed to protect the rights of parties while the court deliberates on the full merits of a case. South Africa's filing marks an escalation in the legal dispute, moving beyond the initial complaint to formally document what it describes as noncompliance with the court's interim rulings.
